description: This Java source file defines a final class 'ModifyFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl' which is a builder for creating responses and events related to modifying feature definitions in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes nested classes for response and event factories, and methods for generating specific response types and events.
